gloss: to run through; to run past; to run to the end

definitions.gloss: to run through; to run past; to run to the end
definitions.explanation: To run through a place or past something without stopping, or to run all the way to the finish; figuratively, to get through a hard period at full speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}けた。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}けていく。
examples.english: The train runs through the station without stopping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}けて、⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧。
examples.english: I ran flat out to the very end and dashed across the finish line.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive, but the place passed through takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}ける), as with other verbs of motion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人混|ひとご}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}ける: to run through a crowd
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}ける: to run all the way to the end
- ⟦{青春|せいしゅん}→青春：14613_seishun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}ける: to race through one's youth (figurative)

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run) + 〜⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (through, to the end).
